name: Seazonify
author: Md Mim Akhtar

sections.description:
Seazonify is the ultimate seasonal engagement and UX enrichment platform for WordPress. Whether it is the magic of falling snow in winter, the serenity of autumn leaves in the fall, or festive fireworks for a celebration, Seazonify allows you to transform your website’s atmosphere with a single click.

Unlike generic effect plugins that rely on bloated third-party libraries or slow external CDNs, Seazonify 1.0.5+ is built with a 100% Local-First Architecture. This means every single one of our 50+ premium effects is bundled directly within the plugin.

Why Choose Seazonify?

  • Premium Library: Access 50+ high-fidelity visual and audio effects, including 3D maple leaves, realistic rainfall, crackling fireplaces, and cinematic holiday themes.
  • Performance First: Built with modern CSS3 and GPU-accelerated JavaScript, our effects are designed to be “invisible” to your site’s performance, ensuring zero impact on your Core Web Vitals.
  • Total Privacy: Seazonify does not track your visitors, collect personal data, or use external cookies. We are 100% GDPR compliant by design.
  • Live Customizer Integration: Preview your seasonal transformation in real-time. Fine-tune your visuals and audio using the native WordPress Customizer before your visitors ever see them.
  • Enterprise-Grade Reliability: Our “Self-Healing Asset Resolver” dynamically resolves file paths locally, ensuring your effects work perfectly on development, staging, and production domains without manual configuration.

Features

1. High-Performance Visual Effects

From subtle ambient particles to cinematic overlays, our visuals use hardware-accelerated rendering:
* Weather: Realistic Snow, Rain, Thunderstorms, and Mist.
* Nature: 3D Maple Leaves, Cherry Blossoms, Fireflies, and Spring Blooms.
* Holidays: Christmas, New Year, Ramadan, Diwali, Republic Day, and more.

2. Immersive Audio Soundscapes

Create a complete sensory experience by layering audio effects that play seamlessly in the background:
* Nature Ambience: Forest birds, ocean waves, and gentle rain.
* Cozy Interiors: Crackling fireplaces and ambient wind.
* Special events: Curated audio for festive celebrations.

3. Smart Combo Presets

Don’t want to mix and match? Use our “Combo” library to apply pre-configured pairings of vision and sound for a perfectly balanced seasonal vibe.

4. Admin & Performance Tools

  • Lazy Loading: Only the selected effect’s assets are loaded. No global bloat.
  • Rate Limiting: Protects your site’s resources during high-traffic surges.
  • Security Built-in: Follows strict WordPress.org coding standards, with no eval() or unauthorized remote calls.

External services

Seazonify uses a minimal, secure connection to our backend exclusively for account lifecycle management.

1. Seazonify API (https://api.seazonify.com)

This is our authentication and connectivity bridge. It is used ONLY for the initial connection between your WordPress site and your Seazonify account.

Key Technical Details:
* OTP-Based Auth: Securely connect using a one-time password (OTP) instead of sharing sensitive account credentials.
* Connectivity Status: The plugin occasionally pings the /api/plugin/v1/status endpoint to verify your account connection remains active.
* ZERO Local Data Export: No visitor data, site content, or administrative logs are ever sent to our API.
* Bundled Assets: NO effect metadata, scripts, images, or audio files are fetched from this API. 100% of the libraries are bundled locally for maximum speed and security.

Service Documents:
* Terms of Service
* Privacy Policy

Source Code & Build Tools

Seazonify is fully committed to the Open Source spirit of the WordPress community. While we include minified assets for production efficiency, we maintain 100% source code transparency.

  • Official GitHub: https://github.com/itsmimakhtar/Seazonify
  • Transparency Mapping: Every production file in the dist/ folders maps directly to a human-readable counterpart in our src/ folders (e.g., controller.js ↔ controller-src.js).
sections.installation:
Seazonify is designed for a frictionless setup process:

  1. Download the plugin from the WordPress repository.
  2. Upload the seazonify folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to the new Seazonify menu in your admin sidebar.
  5. Follow the simple on-screen instructions to connect your account and start exploring the effects library.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect my SEO or page load speed?

No. Seazonify is built with performance as a primary goal. It uses native browser APIs and GPU acceleration. We also utilize lazy-loading so that if no effect is active, zero secondary assets are loaded.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes! All visual effects are responsive. We also include a “Disable on Mobile” toggle for sites that prefer a more traditional mobile experience.

Can I use it on a Multisite network?

Absolutely. Seazonify is fully compatible with WordPress Multisite installations.

Why do I need to connect an account?

Connecting an account allows us to keep your effects metadata updated securely and provides you with access to our growing library of premium 3D effects.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Compliance Hardening: Removed all remaining remote CDN references flagged in the latest review pass.
  • Source Transparency: Added explicit mapping and documentation for all minified production assets.
  • Architecture: Unified the dynamic asset resolver for 100% local, environment-agnostic loading.

1.0.4

  • Ultimate Localization: Transitioned to a 100% bundled, local-first architecture. Our entire effects library is now part of the plugin package.
  • Self-Healing Path Resolver: Implemented dynamic site-aware pathing to prevent broken assets on migrations.
  • Security: Total elimination of external CDN dependencies (jsDelivr/GitHub).
  • Fixes: Resolved asset path issues in “International Women’s Day” and “Autumn Leaves 3D”.

1.0.3

  • Refined rate limiter transient prefixes for repository compliance.
  • Extensive documentation updates.

1.0.2

  • Localized main engine and removed inline styling.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
